# Stouls Studio

> Interior architecture and design studio in Paris run by Margaux Stouls. Apartment search, technical drawings, site supervision and furnishing, in Paris and beyond, for a primary residence, a pied-à-terre, a rental investment or a resale. Works in English and in French.

- [Buy and renovate an apartment in Paris | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/): Margaux Stouls, interior architect and designer in Paris, finds your apartment, designs it, supervises the renovation and furnishes it while you stay in the US or Canada.
- [Services: from apartment search to handover | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/services/): Two ways to work with interior architect and designer Margaux Stouls in Paris: from the apartment search to the keys, or the full renovation of an apartment you already own.
- [Buying an apartment in Paris from abroad | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/apartment-search-paris/): Looking at apartments for sale in Paris from the US or Canada? An interior architect searches, visits them for you and tells you what each one could become before you make an offer.
- [Paris apartment renovation, managed for you | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/paris-apartment-renovation/): Design, technical drawings, materials, site supervision and furnishing for your Paris apartment, by interior architect and designer Margaux Stouls, from the first plan to the keys.

- [What is a pied-à-terre? Meaning and pronunciation | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/glossary/pied-a-terre/): A pied-à-terre is a small second home in a city, kept for short stays. Meaning, pronunciation, plural, and what owning one in Paris involves.
- [What is a Haussmann apartment? | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/glossary/haussmann-apartment/): A Haussmann (Haussmannian) apartment is in one of the cut-stone buildings from the rebuilding of Paris, 1853 to 1870. How to recognize one, its layout, and what a renovation changes.
- [What is a chambre de bonne? | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/glossary/chambre-de-bonne/): A chambre de bonne is a former servant's room under the roof of a Paris building, usually 6 to 12 m² (65 to 130 sq ft). The legal minimum size to rent one, and what can be done with it.
- [Copropriété and syndic explained | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/glossary/copropriete-syndic/): A copropriété is a building owned in shares by its apartment owners. The syndic is the managing agent they appoint. What each does, what you pay, and what they decide about your renovation.
- [Paris apartment renovation cost per m² | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/paris-apartment-renovation-cost/): What Paris firms publish for renovation cost per m², from a refresh to a full premium renovation, why two apartments of the same size differ, and the costs on top of the contractor's quote.
- [Buying an apartment in Paris from Canada | Stouls Studio](https://stoulsstudio.com/canadian-buyers-paris/): Stouls Studio's first overseas clients were Canadian. How a Canadian buyer finds, buys, renovates and furnishes a Paris apartment without being there, in English or French.
